attchmntText: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by CARE Ratings Limited. The report concerns the Qualified Institutional Placement aggregating Rs. 594.84 crore. The monitoring agency noted that utilization was not fully as per the Offer Document. Delays occurred in utilizing proceeds for strategic investments and general corporate purposes. No board approval was obtained for these delays. Funds for strategic investments were commingled with other business transactions in the company's current account. For general corporate purposes, the company took reimbursements totaling Rs. 75 crore. Rs. 40.82 crore of this pertains to Q1FY27. Transactions occurred in current accounts while reimbursements were taken from the cash credit account. The company has invested unutilized proceeds of Rs. 296.47 crore in fixed deposits with AU Small Finance Bank and ICICI Bank. The report was reviewed by the Audit Committee and Board of Directors.

attchmntText: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 122504 securities pursuant to ESOP/ESPS at its meeting held on November 13, 2026
voiceSummary: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited approved the allotment of 1,22,504 equity shares to employees under the Zaggle Employee Stock Option Scheme 2022 on November 13, 2026. The shares have a face value of INR 1. The exercise price was INR 164 for 828 shares and INR 1 for 1,21,676 shares. The company's paid-up equity share capital increased from INR 13,44,58,445 to INR 13,45,80,949. The total issued shares are now 13,45,80,949. The allotted shares rank pari-passu with existing equity shares. In-principle approval for the scheme was previously obtained from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited. The Board meeting concluded at 04:00 PM IST.

attchmntText: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue from operations of 10,031 million rupees for H1FY27, a 31.3% increase from 7,642 million rupees in H1FY26. Quarterly revenue for Q2FY27 was 5,799 million rupees, up 34.2% from 4,322 million rupees in Q2FY26. Operating cash flow turned positive at both standalone and consolidated levels. The Dice acquisition contributed SaaS revenues, with approximately 70% of customer contracts novated. The company established Zaggle Holdings Limited in Abu Dhabi Global Market. Adjusted EBITDA margin for H1FY27 was 7.9%, compared to 10.5% in H1FY26. Profit after tax for H1FY27 was 1,420 million rupees, down from 2,091 million rupees in H1FY26.

attchmntText: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited - Quarter & Half yearly performance highlights".
voiceSummary: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited announced unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations increased by 34.2 percent to Rs. 10,031 million for the half year. Adjusted EBITDA decreased by 0.8 percent to Rs. 793 million. Profit after tax fell by 31.3 percent to Rs. 420 million for the half year. The company reported positive operating cash flow at both standalone and consolidated levels for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. SaaS revenue reached its highest quarterly performance due to novated contracts from the Dice acquisition. Employee and other expenses rose due to acquisition-related additions and marketing costs. Cashback as a percentage of revenue stood at 66.2 percent. The company established Zaggle Holdings Limited in Abu Dhabi Global Market to expand international presence.

attchmntText: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited approved its Standalone and Consolidated Un-audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors held the meeting on November 13, 2026, starting at 03:00 PM IST and concluding at 04:00 PM IST. The company has enclosed the financial results along with Limited Review Reports issued by the Statutory Auditor. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 and 33 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The information is submitted to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited for their records.

attchmntText: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Nomination and Remuneration Committee / Compensation Committee Meeting held on November 13, 2026 regarding Grant of Options under Zaggle Employee Stock Option Scheme 2022
voiceSummary: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited granted 77,071 stock options to eligible employees under the Zaggle Employee Stock Option Scheme 2022. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee approved this grant on November 13, 2026. Each option is convertible into one equity share with a face value of ₹ 1. The exercise price is set at ₹ 130 per stock option. This price reflects a 25% discount to the closing market price on November 12, 2026. Options are exercisable from the vesting date until ten years after the final tranche vests. The allotted shares are not subject to any lock-in period. The scheme complies with SEBI Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity Regulations, 2021.
